good_when: The developers read each objective as one end that one role reaches in their own work, with that role as the one who reaches it: for the developer who calls the library, what they reach in their own work rather than what their code does; for the developer who sets up the command, what they are left with once it is done rather than the install task itself.
The developers know, when they read O2, what 'before' means: the results their code gave before they updated invoicer.
